rival_reading: A local farm shipment could pass through a temporary gate with its ordinary return count; an entry-time mismatch alone does not establish a failed evacuation.
gloss: A route tally and return count preserve different records of a crossing.
title: Pass count complete, exit count blank
body: The map's lane is crossed out before the last crossing is tallied. A child's drawing is folded in the lunchbox; the only complete count is for returned passes.

rival_reading: A road-control crew could inventory containers during a diversion and record field goods; the timing does not prove a program exposure.
gloss: A field water total and a container return are recorded around a lane crossing.
title: Field total before lane crossing
body: The bucket's water total is entered before the last lane crossing. A child's drawing is folded inside the lunchbox; the only checked box asks whether the bucket came back.
